visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair in a bun, wearing a black sleeveless tank top and a silver necklace, sits on a wooden floor in a living room. She smiles widely at the camera while holding a black and bronze kitchen appliance. Behind her is a light-colored sofa with patterned pillows. (2) Close-up shot inside the appliance's pot, where slices of zucchini, carrots, and dumplings are arranged in a circular pattern. A hand enters the frame and sprinkles black pepper from a green-capped container over the ingredients. (3) A series of fast cuts showing food preparation: sliced onions and ginger are stirred in the pot with a white spatula; a metal basket dumps chopped green cabbage into the pot; vegetable slices are meticulously layered on top of the cabbage base. (4) The woman is now in a modern kitchen with wooden cabinets. She looks upwards with an exaggerated expression of heat, fanning herself with a spatula. She then points to the appliance on the counter and transitions back to her seated position in the living room. (5) A young man in a black tank top joins the woman. They sit side-by-side behind the appliance, pointing at its lid and smiling enthusiastically. The man places his arm around the woman's shoulder as they present the product. (6) Close-up shots of the appliance's digital interface showing various cooking modes like 'pressure' and 'steam.' Graphic overlays appear, displaying pictures of cooked dishes like red bean soup and braised pork, accompanied by percentage statistics and technical diagrams of the pot's interior heating mechanism. (7) The woman and man are shown eating the cooked dumplings and vegetables from small bowls using chopsticks. They exhibit exaggerated expressions of enjoyment, nodding at each other while looking at the food. (8) The final scene takes place in the kitchen again. The woman holds the appliance while the man stands behind her. Animated graphics of a stainless steel pot and a water purifier float in the air around them, along with text related to a promotional event.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal female vocal starts immediately with a friendly and energetic tone over an upbeat acoustic guitar BGM. A percussive 'click' and 'clink' sound signify the opening of the appliance lid. (2) Sizzling white-noise effect mimics the sound of sautéing ingredients. The female voice transitions into a slightly lower pitch, assuming a professional narrative style as she explains the cooking process. (3) A series of 'whoosh' transition sound effects with high spectral flux punctuate the fast visual cuts. The vocal energy remains high with frequent rising intonations. (4) Male vocal enters with a deep, resonant timbre, engaging in a conversational banter with the female voice. Their speech rate is fast and rhythmic, synchronized with the upbeat background music. (5) Mechanical digital beeps and 'ding' sound effects are used to highlight the appearance of on-screen graphics and technical statistics. The acoustic environment is clean with no perceptible background hum. (6) Audible slurping and chewing sounds (crunching transients) are isolated in the mix to emphasize the food's texture. Female and male vocals emit high-arousal positive exclamations like 'Mmm.' (7) The audio concludes with a clear spoken call-to-action regarding a promotion, followed by a bright, high-frequency digital chime as the sound fades.
